summary: The main article describes a ruthenium(II)-catalyzed deacylative annulation of 1,3-diones with sulfoxonium ylides to synthesize substituted furans. The document includes optimization tables, substrate scope schemes for both 1,3-diones and sulfoxonium ylides, and mechanistic control experiments.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Transition metal-catalyzed C -C bond activation of 1,3diones.
items.description: Compares previous work on transition metal-catalyzed C-H functionalization and deacylative a-cupration with the current work's deacylative C-C ruthenation/annulation.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Selected optimization studies a
items.description: Lists the screening of solvents, bases, and additives to optimize the yield and chemoselectivity of the furan product 3aa.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Scope of 1,3-diones.
items.description: Displays the variety of 1,3-dione substrates tolerated in the reaction, including those with different electronic and steric properties.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Scope of sulfoxonium ylides.
items.description: Shows the scope of aroyl and alkenoyl sulfoxonium ylides that can be used to synthesize various substituted furans.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: Gram-scale reactions and control experiments.
items.description: Illustrates scale-up experiments and several mechanistic control reactions to investigate the C-C bond cleavage process.

items.heading: Scheme 5
items.caption: Plausible catalytic cycle.
items.description: Proposes a mechanism involving Ru-carbene formation, C-C bond activation, migratory insertion, and intramolecular annulation.
